claims.text: 细碎CTC颗粒通常比大叶完整茶更快出味，冲泡时应参照生产商说明并按口味调整，不能假定同一冲泡公式适用于所有茶。

citations.quote: Fine CTC particles generally infuse faster than larger whole leaves, so follow the producer's directions and adjust to taste rather than assuming one brewing formula applies to every tea.

claims.text: 调味茶和香薰茶属于产品描述，不是独立的基础茶类；识别底层茶时需要查看基茶是红茶、绿茶、乌龙茶、白茶、黄茶还是黑茶，并查看配料或香气来源是否列出。

citations.quote: A flavored tea and a scented tea are product descriptions rather than separate basic tea types. Flavoring can be added to a tea base, while scenting may transfer aroma from aromatic materials during processing. To identify the underlying tea, check whether the base is black, green, oolong, white, yellow, or dark tea and whether ingredients or aroma sources are listed.

claims.text: 茶树品种与茶类是两个不同概念：茶树品种描述栽培植物的选择，红茶、绿茶、乌龙茶、白茶、黄茶和黑茶描述加工后的产品类型。

citations.quote: Tea cultivar and tea type are different concepts. Cultivar describes the cultivated plant selection; black, green, oolong, white, yellow, and dark tea describe processed product types.

claims.text: 同一茶树品种经过六种典型加工方法可产生不同的化学特征，茶树品种不单独决定成品茶类型或香气，加工方式也起作用。

citations.quote: A research study indexed by FAO AGRIS reports that processing one cultivar by six typical methods produced differentiated chemical profiles. Therefore, cultivar alone does not determine the finished tea type or its aroma; processing also matters.

claims.text: 实用的茶叶产品描述可以组合基础加工类型、茶树品种、产地、制造风格、等级、添加配料和产品形态；这些属性回答不同问题，不应合并成一个茶类标签。

citations.quote: A practical tea product description can combine several attributes: basic processing type, cultivar, origin, manufacturing style, grade, added ingredients, and product form. For example, a product can be described as black tea from a named origin, made by orthodox processing, scented with jasmine, and sold loose leaf. These attributes answer different questions and should not be collapsed into a single tea-family label.

message: 红茶的发酵是微生物发酵还是氧化？

response.answer:
• 红茶加工中的行业用语“发酵”通常指茶叶被破坏并暴露于空气后发生的酶促氧化，这种过程与微生物发酵不同。
来源：Fermentation: The Key Step in Processing of Black Tea

• ISO 20715 所列红茶加工包括萎凋、揉捻或切碎、通气/氧化和干燥；茶叶贸易中的“发酵”常指这一由酶驱动的氧化步骤，不一定表示微生物使叶片发酵。
来源：ISO 20715:2023 Tea — Classification of tea types

• 红茶被描述为氧化茶，原因在于其定义性加工涉及酶驱动的氧化步骤，而非必然涉及微生物发酵。
来源：ISO 20715:2023 Tea — Classification of tea types

• 绿茶制作中会快速加热鲜叶以钝化酶，随后可能包括揉捻、造型或粉碎及干燥；与红茶相比，绿茶不经过红茶工艺中有意通气/氧化的步骤。
来源：ISO 20715:2023 Tea — Classification of tea types

• 一项针对伊朗吉兰（Gilan）红茶的研究把其加工步骤描述为萎凋、揉捻、发酵（氧化）和干燥，并在实验室条件下比较冲泡方法、测定化学性质。
来源：Processing and brewing of Gilan black tea, Journal of Food Science and Technology

• 黑茶可能涉及单独的渥堆或后发酵阶段；询问茶是否发酵时需要澄清所指的具体过程。
来源：Fermentation: The Key Step in Processing of Black Tea
